description: Two live owners in two processes on one row. In each phase process a begins a transaction and updates N of row 1; process b begins its own and updates V of the same row (errors recorded, default engine options); then the transactions resolve in the given order (tokens: A/B owner, C commit, R rollback): phase 1 'A:C B:C', phase 2 'B:R A:C'. After each phase both processes read rows 1, 2 and 64 and row 1 of U.
